\caption{Repaying a summary. (a)~Time to decode one output token against context length on one GPU;
Qwen3.8-27B uses full attention in 16 of its 64 layers, Qwen3-32B in all 64; the open mark comes from a
later session. (b--e)~Estimated steps a summary must be used to repay its one-time cost, against the steps
it was used before the next summary; in the shaded area, the estimate is below the steps used. (b,c)~S
runs' summaries (dots, jittered), priced as in Table~\ref{tab:prices}; circles are run medians. (d,e)~S
replays of GLM switch points; the vertical position extrapolates the 20 replayed steps linearly, and filled
marks are replays whose reconstructed time fell below L's within them. Steps used come from the GLM run;
summaries cut short by the end of a run are left out.}
\label{fig:payback}
\end{figure*}
